purpose: Pre-reveal registration of the experiment details H16-H22 leave open. Written 2026-10-02 by the orchestrator BEFORE any Engine code or H16-H22 evidence exists. Refines, never changes, FREEZE.json thresholds.

engine_scope.decision: A new in-process generic Engine (round2/src/eoo_engine) executes both domains from their Gate-0 IR files (domains/*/ir.json, unchanged). The Docker-based v1 POC stack is NOT re-platformed; manufacturing external effects go through an in-process fake WMS adapter. Every verdict must disclose this.

kernel_snapshot.note: H16 'kernel-before' = this list + the Engine dispatch table as first committed; Project Ontology IR was authored after the freeze (commit 9789f48 after 6292715) against the frozen schema.

logic_bindings.rule: Functions, policy expressions, preconditions, outcome predicates and constraint expressions are domain LOGIC registered by their IR ref (implementation_ref / expression_ref / predicate text) in round2/domains/<d>/logic/. The Engine owns WHEN and HOW they are evaluated and how their results combine; logic code receives a read-only view and returns values only.

H17.oracle_independence: The reference transition model lives in round2/oracles/h17/ and must not import eoo_engine or domains/*/logic.

task_classes.description: Enforce the six docs/04 hard rules (preregistration completeness, post-freeze threshold immutability, RUNNING requires freeze hash, evidence binds version+commit+environment, verdict machine-derived, orphan flagged not deleted).

Answer three fixed queries over real H15 artifacts: (q1) which evidence files and commit support H15's verdict; (q2) which components have no link to an active hypothesis; (q3) which hypotheses are blocked by a non-SUPPORTED upstream dependency.

Add object type Replication (props: id, experiment_ref, outcome) + link REPLICATES Replication->Experiment + governed action register_replication (git_change) + function count_replications, with lifecycle rule: a replication may be registered only for an EVALUATED experiment.

H18.bespoke_surface_metric: Per task class and variant: handwritten Python LOC (non-blank, non-comment) + handwritten declarative config lines (IR JSON / JSON Schema / YAML / CI config), each reported separately and as a total. Generated files are excluded only if produced by a tool that both variants may use. EOO's shared Engine/Toolchain code is NOT counted per task (it is the recurring tax, reported separately as recurring_complexity_loc); the baseline's shared scripts likewise. Support needs total <= 0.75 x baseline total in >=1 class with no correctness loss.
H18.baseline: Git + JSON files + JSON Schema + Python CI scripts in round2/baselines/h18_fileonly/, implementing the SAME invariants, verified against the SAME independent lifecycle oracle (src/hdd/project_lifecycle_reference.py) and the same task queries.
H18.git_rule: Experiments mutate only temporary repositories (git init under a temp dir) seeded from the real round2 artifacts read via git show; the real repository is never written by Engine actions.

H19.oracle: round2/oracles/h19/: pure immutable commit-DAG + deterministic projection, no Engine imports, never reads the Engine's store.

adapter_allowed: translate an approved effect into an external/system call
emit observations from the external system
H20.forbidden_core_tokens: any domain id, package id, object/link/action/function/policy id from domains/*/ir.json appearing in Engine core code or as a branch condition
H20.synthetic_resource: Hypothesis-generated object type + action + function using existing kinds, executed with zero Engine edits.

H21.interface_case: VersionedResearchObject (6 implementers in project IR) and Statused (4 in manufacturing): one generic interface tool must serve all implementers with no per-type code.
H21.authority_oracle: round2/oracles/h21/: independent capability reference model; the Toolchain must not import it.
H21.baseline: Generic OpenAPI generation over the same IR treated as a conventional schema, with hand-written authorization glue; contextual, reported, not a support condition.

H22.decision: Only 2 real domains exist. Per the preregistered gate (min_real_domains_for_verdict=3) the evaluator must return INCONCLUSIVE; no synthetic third domain may be counted as real.
